front: Channel a 1-2 action attack or save spell into a melee Strike, delivering both at once. You must recharge before using it again.
back:
Cast a 1-2 action spell with an attack roll or save; make a melee Strike with weapon or unarmed attack. Counts as two attacks for MAP, applied after Spellstrike. Strike gains arcane trait.
Attack-roll spell: Strike's result determines both effects.
Save spell: target saves normally regardless of your roll, unless Strike crit fails, which disrupts the spell.
Combine Strike and spell damage for resistances/weaknesses.
Recharge: single action (concentrate), or cast a conflux spell taking 1+ actions. Other focus spells don't recharge.
